_README: `expect` is the pdf_id of the judgment that should rank first. Ground truth
here was read off the judgments themselves (FACTS and LEGAL_ISSUES), not
`note` says WHY that judgment is the answer, so a disagreement can be
settled by reading the judgment rather than by argument.
Queries are grouped by what they are testing. The `paraphrase` group is the
important one: those share little or no vocabulary with the judgment, which
is exactly the case keyword search cannot handle and the whole system
THIS SET IS TOO SMALL. Seventeen to twenty queries over eleven judgments
carries a confidence interval of roughly +/-12 points, which cannot resolve
the differences this harness is meant to measure. Before the 1000-document
run, grow it to at least 50 and ideally 100 queries. Add one query per
judgment as you ingest, while its subject matter is fresh.

queries.query: Is a claim relating to dower within the jurisdiction of a Family Court?
queries.note: C.A. 23-P/2017 held the revenue-record dispute was in no way a matter relating to dower.

queries.query: dispute over wrong entries in the revenue record between spouses
queries.note: Same judgment, described by its facts rather than its legal question.

queries.query: trade mark assignment agreement was incorrectly relied upon
queries.note: C.A. 57-K/2018, the Shezan trade mark assignment.

queries.query: who owns a brand name after a company is restructured
queries.note: Shezan, asked without using the words trade mark or assignment.

queries.query: election petition where the winning margin was only sixty five votes
queries.note: C.A. 1/2020, PB-08 Barkhan, returned by a margin of 65 votes.

queries.query: challenge to a narrow win in a provincial assembly constituency in Balochistan
queries.note: Same judgment; distinguishes it from the NA-266 election case below.

queries.query: general elections 2013 National Assembly seat NA-266 Nasirabad Jaffarabad
queries.note: C.A. 5-Q/2014. Deliberately near the other election case, to test discrimination.

queries.query: evacuee land granted and later disputed in Tando Adam
queries.note: C.A. 42-K/2016, 56 acres and 28 ghuntas in Deh and Taluqa Tando Adam, Sanghar.

queries.query: agricultural land allotted after partition and the title later questioned
queries.note: The evacuee land case, phrased as a lawyer would describe it to a colleague.

queries.query: seniority and promotion of police officers before a service tribunal
queries.note: C.A. 3-L/2016, ASI and SI seniority, Punjab Service Tribunal.

queries.query: lower school course dates determining a police officer's seniority
queries.note: Distinguishes the Punjab police case from the Federal Service Tribunal cases.

queries.query: did the Service Tribunal have jurisdiction to entertain the service appeal
queries.note: C.A. 1-K/2021 frames exactly this issue; remanded to be decided afresh.

queries.query: civil servant denied a fair opportunity of hearing by the tribunal
queries.note: Second framed issue of C.A. 1-K/2021.

queries.query: contempt application dismissed by the High Court of Balochistan
queries.note: C.P. 34-Q/2019, Contempt Application No. 1/2014.

queries.query: when will this Court decline leave to appeal under Article 185(3)
queries.note: C.P. 34-Q/2019 discusses Article 185(3) and declines leave.

queries.query: civil revision dismissed by the High Court of Balochistan at Quetta
queries.note: C.A. 43-Q/2018, civil revision dismissed by Balochistan High Court.

queries.query: constitutional petitions decided by the High Court of Sindh at Karachi in 2021
queries.note: C.A. 26-K to 38-K/2021, against the Sindh High Court judgment of 08.04.2021.

queries.query: two service appeals raising common questions of law decided together
queries.note: C.A. 06 and 724/2016, expressly decided by a single judgment on common questions.

queries.query: appeal allowed and the impugned judgment set aside with parties bearing their own costs
queries.note: C.A. 1/2020's final order, near-verbatim. Tests FINAL_ORDER retrieval.

queries.query: appeal dismissed with no order as to costs for want of merit
queries.note: C.A. 42-K/2016's final order. Deliberately close to the query above, opposite outcome.
